glosses: to blind
to dazzle, to spellbind
beroven van het vermogen te zien

examples.text: De op hem gerichte schijnwerper verblindde hem volledig.

glosses: een illusie geven aan, misleiden
To confuse or overpower the sight of (someone or something, such as a sensor) by means of excessive brightness.

examples.text: Dazzled by the headlights of the lorry, the deer stopped in the middle of the street.
Antidrone lasers can burn or dazzle a drone's sensors.
Those heavenly shapes / Will dazzle now the earthly, with their blaze / Insufferably bright.
An unreflected light did never yet / Dazzle the vision feminine.

glosses: To render incapable of thinking clearly; to overwhelm with showiness or brilliance.

examples.text: The delegates were dazzled by the originality of his arguments.

glosses: To be overpowered by light; to be confused by excess of brightness.

examples.text: For we see, that an over-light maketh the Eyes dazel, insomuch as perpetual looking against the Sun, would cause blindness.
[…] I dare not trust these Eyes; / They Dance in Mists, and dazle with surprize.

glosses: A light of dazzling brilliancy.
Showy brilliance that may stop a person from thinking clearly.
A herd of zebra.

examples.text: We were trying to stalk a dazzle of zebra which flashed in and out of a long strip of green and yellow fever trees, with an ostrich, its feathers flared like a ballet skirt around its dancing legs, on their flank, when suddenly […]
Zebras move in herds which are known as "dazzles." When a lion approaches a dazzle of zebras during its hunt, […]
I reached the lodge as a dazzle of zebras trotted across the dirt road into thorny scrub by the game fence, and a lone kudu gazed up at me from the short grass near the swimming pool.
A group of zebras can be called a dazzle.

glosses: Dazzle camouflage.
Privar de la vista a alguien.
Ofuscar la vista o confundirla con la demasiada luz.
Dejar a uno dudoso, incierto y confuso, de suerte que no conozca el verdadero designio o intento de otro.
Producir impresión con estudiado exceso de lujo.
Arrojar rayos.
Disparar o lanzar un proyectil mortal.
Causar una muerte repentina.

examples.text: Conoce bien a su padre. No, ningún ataque repentino ha de fulminarlo.

glosses: Impresionar mucho a una persona al punto de dejarlo sin respuesta o reacción.
Dificultar la visión o el reconocimiento por medios diversos.
Inspirar ilusiones en alguien, hacer que se forje o tenga expectativas, percepciones o ideas que son resultado de la imaginación o un engaño de los sentidos.
Inspirar o despertar ilusiones, esperanzas o expectativas cuyo resultado parece muy agradable o atractivo.
Inspirar o despertar gran gusto, agrado y complacencia respecto a algo. Hacer ilusión una cosa.
Aveugler.
